items.claim: ResizeHandle commits a release size `onInput` never got
Muted or plain stacked QuantityText reads its value twice
Another tab's `localStorage.clear()` (null `key`) never reaches recent colors
Radio overwrites a consumer's `aria-describedby` when it has a note
RecentColorsProvider provides `null` once `store` is removed after mount
ReorderHandle's refocus flag outlives the move and steals focus later
items.note: The handle now also gets focus back when a memoized row moves without re-rendering it.
